back_translation: On the first day of the month, in the eleventh year, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, because Tyre has said, mocking Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate of the peoples is broken; it has swung open to me; now that she is ruined, I will grow rich,’
therefore the Lord GOD says this: Behold, O Tyre, I am against you, and I will bring many nations up against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down its towers. I will scrape the dust from her and make her a bare rock.
She will become a place to spread nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD. She will become plunder for the nations,
and the villages of Tyre on the mainland will be killed by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
For the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the king of kings, against Tyre from the north, with horses, chariots, cavalry, and a great army.
He will kill your villages on the mainland with the sword. He will set up siege works against you, build a ramp to attack you, and raise shields against you.
He will batter your walls with his battering ram and tear down your towers with his axes.

His horses are so many that their dust will cover you; your walls will shake from the noise of cavalry, wagons, and chariots when he enters your gates like men entering a city whose walls are breached.
The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets. He will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.
They will plunder your wealth and seize your merchandise. They will tear down your walls, demolish your beautiful houses, and throw your stones, timber, and soil into the water.
I will silence the noise of your songs, and the sound of your lyres will no longer be heard.
I will make you a bare rock; you will become a place to spread nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I, the LORD, have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.’
The Lord GOD says this to Tyre: Will not the coastlands quake at the sound of your downfall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter takes place within you?

Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with terror, sit on the ground, trembling every moment and appalled because of you.

They will raise a lament over you, saying, ‘How you have perished, you who were inhabited by seafarers, O renowned city, once mighty on the sea—you and your inhabitants, who spread your terror over all who lived around you!
Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall; the islands in the sea are terrified at your demise.’
For the Lord GOD says this: When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that have no inhabitants, when I bring up the deep over you and the great waters cover you,

then I will bring you down with those who go down to the Pit, to the people of antiquity. I will make you dwell in the world below, among the ancient ruins, with those who go down to the Pit, so that you will no longer be inhabited or be restored to glory in the land of the living.
I will make you an object of horror, and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never be found again, declares the Lord GOD.”
